name: Advanced Gutenberg Blocks
description: Adds extra content blocks to the Gutenberg editor.
project_description:
Advanced Gutenberg Blocks is a Gutenberg blocks module for site builder and editors. Our goal is to make it insanely easy for you to create better and engaging content with Gutenberg.

 ## Advanced Gutenberg Blocks currently includes the following blocks:

 * Section Break (H2)

* Custom Heading

* Heighlighted Text

* Image Grid

* Custom Text Block

* Text + Image Slider - Repeater

* Featured Media

* Image Mosaic

* Media Repeater Grid

* Link Mosaic

* Featured Text

* Text + Image

* Call to Action

* Link List

* Text Mosaic

* Full width Image Slider

* Spacer Block

* FAQ Accordion

* Custom Audio Block
